description: The prima via's regress premise, with Physics III.3, entails the additional accessibility commitment for the VIII.5 mover relation. Not a transcription: induction on accessibility through three premises, and premisesNeeded shows each is needed. It shows that this accessibility commitment is no further commitment for the root routes once III.3 is granted; it does not discharge any prima via premise. Connects results; closes nothing. Its conclusion is not attributed to Aristotle; the distinct source claim prohibits only infinitely many distinct movers.
